name: Baretta
source:
The ruler of Dungeon 5 and a dragon girl.

Her appearance often gives the impression of being competitive and harsh, but she's actually bright, open-minded, and easygoing.

Her way of speaking can sound condescending, but she means no harm.

[From [url=https://fandc.co.jp/dragonsraid2/charactor02.html]Official website[/url]]
